Section 7. Cancellation. Customer may cancel this Agreement at any time
upon thirty (30) days' written notice to Provider. Early termination fees
apply if cancelled within the first twelve (12) months: a fee equal to
three (3) months of the then-current subscription fees.

Section 8. Data return. Upon cancellation, Provider will make Customer
Data available for export for ninety (90) days.

response_text: The cancellation policy in this service agreement allows customers to cancel the agreement at any time with a 30-day written notice to the Provider. However, if the cancellation occurs within the first 12 months, an early termination fee applies, which is equal to three (3) months of the then-current subscription fees. Additionally, upon cancellation, the Provider will make customer data available for export for 90 days.
